About O-IBS

Built for serious business.
Designed for everyday people.

O-IBS stands for Optimised Intelligent Business System. Our focus is straightforward: bring business operations and accounting together, with intelligent assistance built in.

Your time belongs
to your business.

Business owners and small teams often move between paperwork, spreadsheets and separate tools just to understand where things stand.

O-IBS is designed to connect that work: sales, purchases, inventory, banking and accounting, with Bizzy to help you ask questions and prepare next steps.
